widgets_values: Introduce a glass-like reflective surface at the bottom of the frame with gentle distortion, mirroring the subject to enhance dynamic composition and add a surreal, mysterious mood.
nodes.title: 添加倒影

widgets_values: Transform the subject's hair into a smooth, flowing long bob with soft layers. Add a warm honey-blonde balayage with subtle gold highlights. Style with silky, straight texture, parted on the left side, and finish with a low, loose ponytail. Enhance with a delicate pearl hairband. Adjust clothing to a fitted, elegant blouse and high-waisted trousers for a refined, confident aura.
nodes.title: 变成长发

widgets_values: Enhance subject's physique with hyper-realistic, exaggerated muscle definition across chest, arms, back, and legs; sculpt V-shaped torso, broad shoulders, and narrow waist. Refine skin texture to smooth, glossy with subtle pores and sweat highlights. Replace clothing with tight, form-fitting athletic gear (e.g., muscle shirt, compression shorts) to accentuate musculature; add wristbands and headband for intensity.
nodes.title: 猛男肌肉化

widgets_values: Remove all furniture, decor, and fixtures. Recreate empty surfaces with subtle texture overlays and soft shadows. Adjust lighting to enhance open space, ensuring original architectural details like walls and floor patterns remain intact.
nodes.title: 清空家具

widgets_values: Colorize in a vintage film noir style using deep blues, rich purples, and warm amber accents. Apply desaturated tones with high contrast, emphasizing shadows and light. Add subtle color bleed for dramatic depth, and overlay a faint film grain texture. Highlight key elements with warm highlights while maintaining moody, mysterious atmosphere.
nodes.title: 图像上色

widgets_values: Convert image to 16-color pixel art with 128x128 resolution. Apply Floyd-Steinberg dithering, bold outlines, and retro gaming grain. Limit palette to 8-bit colors with 4 shades per primary color. Use sharp anti-aliased edges and monochrome shading for authentic 80s arcade aesthetic.
nodes.title: 像素风格

widgets_values: Apply thick impasto brushstrokes with swirling, dynamic patterns. Use high-contrast, vivid color palette with bold, saturated hues. Emphasize textured, layered paint application for a tactile feel. Incorporate expressive, rhythmic brushwork reminiscent of Van Gogh's signature style.
nodes.title: 梵高风格

widgets_values: Repaint the entire image in Op Art style, using sharp geometric polygons, high-contrast color blocks, and precise angular brushwork to create optical illusions. Employ repetitive patterns, stark black-and-white with vibrant accent colors, and structured grid-like compositions to emphasize rhythmic visual effects.
nodes.title: 多边形风格

widgets_values: Repaint the image in isometric style using 30-degree angles and 2:1 scaling. Apply precise, sharp lines with high-contrast colors and limited shades. Maintain consistent perspective and grid structure.
nodes.title: 等距风格

widgets_values: Transform the main subject into a sculpture composed of weathered, oxidized iron. Apply a deep brown base with rust-red and muted orange highlights to mimic iron oxide. Add rough, flaky texture with visible cracks and grooves. Use diffuse lighting to create soft shadows, emphasizing the material's uneven surface. Incorporate low to medium reflective qualities, with scattered specular highlights on worn areas to suggest age and decay.
nodes.title: 带锈的铁

widgets_values: Transform the image into a cyberpunk action movie poster. Apply neon color grading with high contrast and digital noise. Use futuristic sans-serif typography in electric blue for the title, with secondary text in white. Add cinematic elements like a glowing energy beam and a dynamic, low-angle composition to emphasize intensity and motion.
nodes.title: 电影海报

widgets_values: Apply tilt-shift miniature effect with narrow aperture (f/2.8) for shallow depth of field. Sharpen foreground details (base of model) and softly blur background elements. Increase color saturation by 30% with warm amber tint. Add subtle lens flare and highlight reflections on glossy surfaces. Use tilt-shift filter to create horizontal blur gradient, emphasizing midground focus. Enhance contrast slightly for vivid toy-like lighting.
nodes.title: 微缩世界

widgets_values:
1. Micro-Lighting Adjustment: Use gradient masks to seamlessly blend directional light and ambient shadows along the neck and jawline, ensuring highlight falloff and shadow density match the surrounding areas with a 0.5px feathered transition.  
2. Skin Tone & Texture Unification: Apply a high-frequency mask to harmonize skin tones via color balance layers, then overlay a texture blend of pores, fine hairs, and film grain using a 30% opacity soft light layer to unify micro-details across the blended zone.  
3. Edge Blending Perfection: Feather the neckline with a 1.2px Gaussian blur, then use a luminosity mask to dissolve color transitions, ensuring the edge integrates with the body's fabric folds and head's hairline via a 50/50 gradient layer.
nodes.title: 无缝融合

widgets_values: Transform the scene into winter by adding heavy snowfall, replacing all foliage with bare branches, and coating surfaces in snow. Adjust lighting to cool, diffused tones with soft blue hues. Add frost details to objects, replace clothing with thick winter gear (coat, scarf, gloves, boots), and include overcast skies with light snowflakes drifting. Enhance atmospheric depth with fog and muted color saturation.
nodes.title: 变成冬天

widgets_values: Teleport the subject to a misty forest stream, maintaining their exact pose. Adjust lighting to dappled, soft sunlight filtering through dense canopy, casting elongated shadows. Add water reflections on their clothing and face, with droplets clinging to hair and accessories. Subtly blur the background to emphasize the flowing stream and surrounding mossy rocks. Enhance skin tones with a cool, earthy glow to match the forest atmosphere.
nodes.title: 森林中的小溪边

widgets_values: Pull back from a medium shot to a wide-angle establishing shot, adjusting composition to include the surrounding environment, enhance lighting to emphasize vastness, and shift focus to background elements to highlight isolation and contextual scale.
nodes.title: 镜头拉远

widgets_values: Main light: Single spotlight positioned above and slightly to the side of the subject at 45-degree angle, intense golden-yellow color, sharp highlights on face and upper body. Rim light: Soft white glow at subject's outer edges, creating halos and separating from background. Background light: Subtle cool blue gradient at base of stage, dim intensity to enhance depth. Shadows: Dramatic, elongated shadows under arms and around face. Atmosphere: Slight haze to intensify spotlight contrast and create cinematic drama.
nodes.title: 站在舞台的聚光灯下

widgets_values: Cinematic Re-Lighting: Sculpt the head with warm, directional amber light from the top-left, casting sharp shadows along the jawline and temples, while softening midtones with diffused golden hour haze. Add cool blue highlights on the forehead and cheekbones to mirror the scene’s ambient glow. Contextual Storytelling: Overlay battle-scabbed grime on the eyebrows, sweat beads along the hairline, and a faint blood smear on the chin to reflect a gritty, combat-ready narrative. Color Grading Unification: Apply a desaturated teal-and-gray color grade, enhancing cool undertones in skin and hair while reducing reds and yellows to match the body’s muted palette. Asset & Hair Adaptation: Remove pristine earrings, replace with rusted metal studs; restyle hair into chaotic, wind-tangled strands with damp translucency and flyaway strands to align with the stormy environment. Flawless Final Integration: Seamlessly blend the neckline using a gradient mask, matching the body’s texture with the head’s skin pores and film grain, ensuring uniformity across the entire composite.
nodes.title: 战场上

widgets_values: Apply a realistic de-aging filter to the subject, reducing facial features to a 10-year-old appearance: soften facial contours, enlarge and brighten eyes with expressive pupils, adjust eyebrows to a higher, arched shape. Transform hair to short, voluminous strands with natural highlights, add soft curls if applicable. Smooth skin texture to a youthful, slightly translucent glow, enhance cheekbones and plump lips. Adjust posture to a playful stance, add childlike clothing details like a hoodie or backpack. Refine shadows for a glowing, natural look.
nodes.title: 年龄变小

widgets_values: Redraw the entire image in a vibrant, exaggerated anime style with bold outlines, high saturation colors, and dynamic character expressions, emphasizing emotional storytelling through exaggerated facial features and dramatic lighting contrasts.
nodes.title: 动漫化

widgets_values: 把产品的文字“冰红茶”改成“冰蓝茶”，瓶体的红色变成蓝色，然后把产品融入到一个充满欢快、清凉的派对中，形成产品海报
nodes.title: 提示词补充输入

widgets_values: Convert the image to a pencil sketch with soft, varying line weights using cross-hatching and stippling. Apply light-to-dark shading gradients for depth, enhance with subtle paper grain texture, and add faint pencil smudges for authenticity. Prioritize natural lighting contrasts and hand-drawn imperfections.
nodes.title: 铅笔手绘

widgets_values: Convert the image to a technical blueprint using orthographic projections with isometric shading. Add dimensional annotations in millimeters with precise numerical values, include hatch patterns for material representation, and incorporate schematic elements like scale bars, alignment markers, and labeled structural components. Apply technical drawing conventions such as hidden lines, cross-hatching, and standardized symbol sets for engineering accuracy.
nodes.title: 蓝图

widgets_values: Replace subject's outfit with a fitted wool turtleneck in beige, paired with a tailored navy blazer and straight-leg charcoal trousers. Add a leather belt, minimalist silver watch, and a white leather crossbody bag. Style hair in loose waves with a low ponytail, apply natural makeup with soft pink blush and neutral tones. Replace footwear with sleek white sneakers.
nodes.title: 北欧家具风格

widgets_values:
单图编辑：开启参照输入1
双图编辑：开启参照输入1和2
三图编辑：开启参照输入1、2、3
姿势参考：开启参照输入1和2，输入2姿态参考
